Resolves #21872

🌿 A learn page can no longer hand a reader a Store config the Store never had.

Nine learn pages now name what exists. The Streaming guide configures a Store through its `pipeline` (`Neo.data.connection.Stream` + `Neo.data.parser.Stream`, the shape `examples/grid/streaming/MainStore.mjs` uses) instead of a `proxy` config and a `Neo.data.proxy.Stream` that do not exist. Workspaces shows the `MainView` that `npm run create-app-minimal` writes (`buildScripts/create/appMinimal.mjs:250-266`): `MainStateProvider.mjs` and `stateProvider`, not `MainViewModel.mjs` and `model`. The Grids header-filter preview drops a `filterable` column config that does not exist and shows `filterConfig` instead. Removed and renamed class names follow the engine, and so does the old "view model" wording.

Evidence: L2 (the Portal on this branch's working tree, headless pane) → L2 required (docs-only). Residual: none.

Prescription checked: `learn/guides/datahandling/Streaming.md` against `src/data/Store.mjs` (`pipeline_`) — the guide owns the concern; the Store gets no `proxy` alias (the engine keeps no backwards-compatibility shims).
